Messages.Author: Tuomas Rinta
Messages.Body:
Memories of Mortality states that all damage done by a vampire with
Memories of Mortaliy played on him/her to an ally is reduced to 0, but
what about Blood of Acid. With Blood of Acid, the damage is not
inflicted by the vampire, but as a by-product of the ally's strike. Is
this damage also reduced to 0? And what about Theft of Vitae? Is the
stealing of blood by Theft of Vitae (or any other similar card) reduced
to zero, since it does not actually inflict damage, but steals blood?

Tuomas Rinta
